### 4. Presentation Skill — Namespace Fix

**Affected file**: `skills/office-file-api/devexpress-office-file-api-presentation/references/advanced-features.md`

Fixed a missing `using` block in the "Edit Footer Content" code example (line ~142). The example used types from the `DevExpress.Docs.Office` namespace (`TextParagraphProperties`, `TextProperties`, `SolidFill`) without importing it. Added:

```csharp
using DevExpress.Docs.Office;
using DevExpress.Docs.Presentation;
using System.Drawing;
```

**Why**: These types were moved from `DevExpress.Docs.Presentation` to `DevExpress.Docs.Office` in v26.1 (breaking change). The fix was identified from `skills/feedback.md` review.
